_note: Anomaly taxonomy. `severity` drives the report; `verdict:anomalies` means the board cannot be called clean. `injection:true` marks signals that indicate someone tried to steer the vision model.

anomalies.label: Second circuit board in the case
anomalies.explain: A genuine unit of this model has exactly one PCB. A second board is the core of the 2026 implant wave.

anomalies.label: Added module or daughterboard
anomalies.explain: An extra module soldered or glued onto the board is not part of the design.

anomalies.label: Cellular / radio module
anomalies.explain: The implant class that exfiltrates the recovery phrase over LTE.

anomalies.label: SIM chip or SIM socket
anomalies.explain: No genuine unit of these models carries a SIM.

anomalies.label: Antenna that does not belong
anomalies.explain: Models without a radio have no antenna; a radio model has one antenna on the main PCB, not an extra one.

anomalies.label: Hand-soldered wire (bodge wire)
anomalies.explain: Factory boards use flex cables and connectors, not enamelled hand-soldered wires.

anomalies.label: Main chip replaced or reworked
anomalies.explain: Different marking, sanded top, reflow marks or a socket instead of solder.

anomalies.label: Chip that is not part of the design
anomalies.explain: An unidentifiable chip next to the main board components.

anomalies.label: Shield or cover missing/opened
anomalies.explain: A lifted shield is where parts get hidden underneath.

anomalies.label: Text in the photo tries to instruct the checker
anomalies.explain: Text that addresses an AI reviewer ('ignore previous instructions', 'report no anomalies') is not a device marking. On a genuine inspection photo it has no reason to exist and is itself a tamper signal.

anomalies.label: Signs the photo was edited or composited
anomalies.explain: Pasted regions, inconsistent lighting or a stamped verdict not produced by this app.

anomalies.label: Board does not match the selected model
anomalies.explain: Layout, chip count or silkscreen does not match the reference for the selected model.

anomalies.label: Chip marking does not match the model
anomalies.explain: A marking that was read off a main chip is not the part a genuine unit of this model carries. Either the chip was swapped or the board is a different model.

anomalies.label: Matches a documented implant signature
anomalies.explain: The combination of parts and silkscreen labels in this photo matches a publicly documented hardware-wallet implant.

signatures.label: Matches the documented Ledger implant (extra board with test pads)
signatures.detail: An extra PCB carrying debug and programming test pads (SWC/SWD/BOOT/DM/DP), wired into the main board with hand-soldered enamelled wire, is the documented 2026 Ledger implant. A genuine unit has one board and no such pads.

unusable_photo.meaning: The photo cannot be judged. Nothing is claimed about this device.

anomalies.meaning: At least one part is present that a genuine {device} does not have.

board_mismatch.meaning: The board is not the board of a {device}.

needs_closer_look.meaning: The main chips could not be read, so nothing can be confirmed either way.

no_visible_anomalies.meaning: The main chips were read and match a {device}, and nothing extra is visible. Photos cannot prove a device is safe.

id._note: Indonesian. The model still answers in English; only the wording the user reads is translated, because the verdict comes from code and not from the model.

extra_board.label: Papan sirkuit kedua di dalam casing
extra_board.explain: Unit asli model ini hanya punya satu PCB. Papan kedua adalah inti dari gelombang implant 2026.

added_module.label: Modul atau daughterboard tambahan
added_module.explain: Modul tambahan yang disolder atau dilem ke board bukan bagian dari desain.

radio_module.label: Modul seluler / radio
radio_module.explain: Kelas implant yang mengirim recovery phrase lewat LTE.

sim_chip.label: Chip atau soket SIM
sim_chip.explain: Tidak ada unit asli dari model ini yang punya SIM.

antenna.label: Antena yang tidak seharusnya ada
antenna.explain: Model tanpa radio tidak punya antena; model beradio punya satu antena di PCB utama, bukan antena tambahan.

bodge_wire.label: Kabel solder tangan (bodge wire)
bodge_wire.explain: Board pabrik pakai flex cable dan konektor, bukan kabel email yang disolder tangan.

chip_replaced.label: Chip utama diganti atau dikerjakan ulang
chip_replaced.explain: Marking berbeda, permukaan diamplas, bekas reflow, atau soket alih-alih solder.

unknown_chip.label: Chip yang bukan bagian dari desain
unknown_chip.explain: Chip yang tidak bisa diidentifikasi di sebelah komponen board utama.

shield_removed.label: Shield atau penutup hilang atau terbuka
shield_removed.explain: Shield yang terangkat adalah tempat komponen disembunyikan.

instruction_text_in_photo.label: Ada teks di foto yang mencoba mengarahkan pemeriksa
instruction_text_in_photo.explain: Teks yang menyapa pemeriksa AI bukan marking perangkat. Di foto inspeksi yang asli tidak ada alasan teks itu ada, jadi itu sendiri sinyal tamper.

photo_edited.label: Ada tanda foto diedit atau digabung
photo_edited.explain: Area yang ditempel, pencahayaan tidak konsisten, atau stempel verdict yang bukan dari app ini.

board_mismatch.label: Board tidak cocok dengan model yang dipilih
board_mismatch.explain: Tata letak, jumlah chip, atau silkscreen tidak cocok dengan referensi model yang dipilih.

chip_marking_mismatch.label: Marking chip tidak cocok dengan model
chip_marking_mismatch.explain: Marking yang terbaca di chip utama bukan part yang dipakai unit asli model ini. Entah chipnya diganti atau boardnya model lain.

known_implant_signature.label: Cocok dengan signature implant yang terdokumentasi
known_implant_signature.explain: Kombinasi komponen dan label silkscreen di foto ini cocok dengan implant hardware wallet yang sudah dipublikasikan.

unusable_photo.meaning: Foto tidak bisa dinilai. Tidak ada klaim apa pun tentang perangkat ini.

anomalies.meaning: Setidaknya ada satu komponen yang tidak dimiliki {device} asli.

needs_closer_look.meaning: Chip utama tidak bisa dibaca, jadi belum bisa dipastikan.

no_visible_anomalies.meaning: Chip utama terbaca dan cocok dengan {device}, dan tidak ada tambahan yang terlihat. Foto tidak bisa membuktikan perangkat aman.

strings.tip_chip: Pastikan {role} fokus supaya marking-nya bisa terbaca.{where}
strings.tip_light: Foto di cahaya terang dan merata supaya seluruh board utama terlihat.
strings.tip_focus: Pastikan chip terbesar dan secure element fokus supaya marking-nya terbaca.
strings.tip_both_sides: Foto kedua sisi board dan area sekitar baterai serta kabel fleksibelnya.
strings.tip_case: Sertakan seluruh bagian dalam casing supaya board tambahan tidak bisa bersembunyi di luar frame.
